frozen: 2026-11-12, chosen on the development part only (split.json); the test part is evaluated once with these settings

common.tracker: ZoneTracker defaults: confirm 0.4 s, occlusion 0.5 s, gate 0.5 m
common.mapping: PETS evaluation quadrilateral of camera_detector.py (not a surveyed calibration)

hog_midterm.detector: OpenCV HOG people detector, ROI crop, upscale 2.5, stride 8

yolox_s.detector: YOLOX-s, OpenCV Model Zoo object_detection_yolox_2022nov.onnx (Apache-2.0), full frame letterboxed to 640, class person

development_search: score threshold, NMS overlap, box height limits, foot ratio and tracker gate on a grid; the tracker gate stayed at its default 0.5 m because the gain from a wider gate was within the noise of 54 frames
